besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have a subject and verb ('Die San is ...' / 'hulle woon ...').
besluite.rede: A correct AWS 2017 comma that changes nothing in meaning.

besluite.fout: 'klanke wat min ander tale het' lets a reader take 'wat' as the subject, so the sounds seem to 'have' languages.
besluite.rede: The proposal removes the stumble and still says the sounds occur in few other languages; the protected sentence in the glossary is untouched.

besluite.fout: 'daardie krale' points to the very beads just described, but women today make beads of that kind, not the same old ones.
besluite.rede: 'sulke' says exactly what is meant, and 'maak vandag nog sulke krale' is the natural Afrikaans order.

besluite.fout: The fixed expression is 'van hand tot hand gaan'; 'getrek' breaks it and is unnatural for objects.
besluite.rede: Restores the fixed expression; the distance and the hand-to-hand movement stay exactly the same.
'aan wie jy verbind is' is correct Afrikaans with a generic 'jy', and the switch to 'was' only shifts tense while hinting the bond has ended.

besluite.fout: The separable verb 'bymekaarkom' is written as one word when its parts stand together at the end of the clause.
besluite.rede: A plain spelling correction with no change in meaning.

besluite.fout: 'deel van hoe hulle ... oordra' is a calque of English 'part of how'.
besluite.rede: 'een van die maniere waarop' is the natural Afrikaans construction and keeps the same claim about singing as a means of passing things on.

besluite.fout: ''n bron wat ons ... vertel' can be read as 'a source that we tell'.
besluite.rede: Adding 'vir' removes the misreading; in both versions the source tells us, so the direction is unchanged.
'sing en klap' is ordinary Afrikaans for singing and clapping, and the context of song and dance rules out 'slap'.

besluite.fout: 'in 'n string' is an unnatural, English-sounding word for people dancing one behind the other.
besluite.rede: 'ry' is the plain word for the same formation; the protected 'Meestal dans die mans' stays intact.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses each with its own subject and verb ('Jy praat ...' / 'jy sien ...').
besluite.rede: A correct AWS 2017 comma with no change in meaning.
'het net daarby gekom' reads naturally as 'were added to them', while 'bygekom' drops the reference to the five ways and can be read as 'came round'.

besluite.fout: 'iets by iemand uitkry' ordinarily means getting something out of someone, which reverses the direction a definition of communication needs.
besluite.rede: A real fault in a glossary definition, which only the writer may reword.

besluite.fout: 'sonder een vaste huis' stresses the number one and reads slightly unnaturally; the article or another wording may be meant.
besluite.rede: The point is fair, but rewording a glossary definition belongs to the writer, who can judge whether 'een' was deliberate.
